task: Stabilize local story owner identity across shell boundaries without collapsing independent tasks or agents.
outcome: The same host task and agent can invoke Lattice through different shell parent processes without a false foreign-owner rejection; a different task or agent remains rejected, and degraded ppid identity is clearly diagnosed.
facts: Core ownership consumes a resolved session identity and currently falls back to hostname+root+ppid.
Canonical documents require LATTICE_SESSION_ID as the only generic core owner id and keep provider-specific signals at adapter boundaries.
The accepted Workstream D contract requires a composite taskIdentity + agentOrRoleIdentity; repository-global and thread-only identities are rejected.

Codex, Claude, and agy launchers are installed, but the current parent environment exposes no native stable session variables; supported adapters/wrappers must inject validated dimensions or a bounded generated boundary.
Owner leases are local non-cryptographic write-coordination metadata; takeover semantics remain unchanged.
